SHARED-F-2-S82.title: Consent Data Schema and Persistence Model
SHARED-F-2-S82.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema for consent records including user/session linkage, consent tier (Tier 1 vs Tier 2), timestamps, audit trail, and de-identification flags. Ensure compatibility with existing debug_logger and Mongo utilities.

SHARED-F-2-S83.title: Consent Core Logic and Tier Enforcement
SHARED-F-2-S83.description: Implement core consent enforcement logic including default Tier 1 behavior, Tier 2 escalation, validation of consent state before storing PHI, and integration with de-identification pipeline per HIPAA Safe Harbor rules.

SHARED-F-2-S84.title: Consent Framework Unit and Integration Tests
SHARED-F-2-S84.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier transitions, PHI blocking without Tier 2, correct de-identification behavior, and cross-service enforcement with lead capture and unknown question flows.
